answer: An attester must stake 16% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. Because the vertex stake is held until the forge settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the onyx audit lists each exposure. A farm running 172 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. That is 2 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
